routes.title: Half a Day in Kadıköy
routes.tagline: Ferry in, graze the market, coffee in Moda, sunset on the rocks.
routes.intro: The Asian side's greatest hits in one unhurried afternoon. Everything is walkable; the ferry is the opening act, the sunset is the finale.

stops.title: Ferry to Kadıköy
stops.note: From Karaköy or Beşiktaş — sit outside, this is part of the route, not transport.

stops.title: Graze the çarşı
stops.note: Arrive hungry. Fish market end first, then the lokantas and pickle counters.

stops.title: Turkish coffee toward Moda
stops.note: Pick a roaster on the walk up — the smell will choose for you.

stops.title: Moda seaside for sunset
stops.note: Grab picnic supplies on the way down. The grass above the rocks beats the jetty.

routes.title: A Day Along the Bosphorus
routes.tagline: Village-hop the European shore from Arnavutköy to the fortress, then cross the water for the view back.
routes.intro: The Bosphorus rewards slowness: wooden mansions, waterfront tea, a 15th-century fortress, and a ferry crossing timed for golden hour.

stops.title: Breakfast in Arnavutköy
stops.note: Start among the wooden yalıs before the crowds.

stops.title: Walk Bebek → Rumeli Hisarı
stops.note: The prettiest flat 20 minutes in the city; fortress courtyard at the end.

stops.title: Bus back, ferry across
stops.note: Coastal bus to Beşiktaş, then the Üsküdar ferry as the light turns.

stops.title: Evening on the Üsküdar seawall
stops.note: Tea, simit, the Maiden's Tower lighting up — the day's closing argument.

routes.title: Your First Day in Istanbul
routes.tagline: The monuments before the crowds, lunch off the tourist strip, and a ferry to end it properly.
routes.intro: A first day that earns the hype without the death march: two monuments maximum, real food, and the skyline from the water while the sun drops.

stops.title: Historic peninsula, early
stops.note: Hagia Sophia at opening, one more monument, then out before the crowd peak.

stops.title: Lunch one street back
stops.note: Esnaf lokantası or köfte — never on the monument squares.

stops.title: Wander down to the water
stops.note: Cankurtaran and the sea walls — old Istanbul, suddenly empty.

stops.title: Sunset ferry to Kadıköy
stops.note: End your first day the way locals end every day — on the water.

routes.title: Istanbul When It's Raining
routes.tagline: Steam, coffee, and covered bazaars — the city's best indoor ritual, in the right order.
routes.intro: Rain is a feature here, not a bug: it empties the hammams' waiting lists, makes coffee taste better, and gives you an excuse for a long meyhane evening.

stops.title: Morning hammam
stops.note: A cold, wet day doubles the pleasure of hot marble.

stops.title: Long Turkish coffee
stops.note: Find a covered corner and let the rain do its thing.

stops.title: Meyhane evening
stops.note: Rakı, mezes, and three hours of steam-fogged windows.
